sentences.text: These bail applications are filed under Section 483 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (for short 'BNSS').

2. Petitioner is an accused in Crime No.549 of 2025 of Kodakara Police Station, Thrissur, Crime No.495 of 2025 of Thamarassery Police Station, Kohikode, Crime No.781 of 2025 of North Police Station, Alappuzha, Crime No.348 of 2025 of Panniankara Police Station, Kozhikode, Crime No.617 of 2025 of Nedumkandam Police Station, Idukki and Crime No.59 of 2025 of Veeyapuram Police Station, Alappuzha, all registered for the offence punishable under Section 420 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.
3. According to the prosecution, the accused had with a dishonest intention promised to provide a job visa to the respective defacto complainants for an employment at Portugal, Canada and other BAIL APPL. NO. 10511 OF 2025 2025:KER:66375 countries and induced them to transfer huge amounts and thereafter failed to provide such employment or return the amounts so collected and thereby committed the offences alleged.
Various complaints have been filed by the respective defacto complainants at different police stations.
Petitioner was arrested in the above-mentioned crimes on 03.08.2025, 26.08.2025, 06.08.2025, 13.06.2025, 08.08.2025 and 06.08.2025 respectively and he has been in custody since then.

4. Heard the learned counsel for the petitioner as well as the respective learned Public Prosecutors.
5.
Petitioner is alleged to have cheated various defacto complainants after promising to provide employment to them outside India and collected large amounts of money.
Though the allegations are serious, it is noticed that in the first crime, petitioner was arrested on 13.06.2025 and he has been in custody since then.
6. Taking note of the period of custody already undergone, I am of the view that petitioner can be released on bail in the above crimes.

Though the learned Public Prosecutor pointed out that altogether nine crimes have been registered against the petitioner, taking note of the period of custody undergone by him from 13.06.2025, further detention is not necessary.

In the result, these bail applications are allowed on the following BAIL APPL. NO. 10511 OF 2025 2025:KER:66375 conditions:-
(a) Petitioner shall be released on bail on him executing a bond for Rs.50,000/-
(Rupees fifty thousand only) each with two solvent sureties each for the like sum to the satisfaction of the court having jurisdiction.

sentences.text: (b) Petitioner shall appear before the Investigating Officer as and when required.
(c) Petitioner shall not intimidate or attempt to influence the witnesses; nor shall he tamper with the evidence.
(d) Petitioner shall not commit any similar offences while he is on bail.
(e) Petitioner shall not leave India without the permission of the Court having jurisdiction.

In case of violation of any of the above conditions or if any modification or deletion of the conditions are required, the jurisdictional Court shall be empowered to consider such applications, if any, and pass appropriate orders in accordance with law, notwithstanding the bail having been granted by this Court.

Sd/-
